name: upstash
description: Manage Upstash resources from the agent through the official @upstash/mcp-server — provision, scale, back up, and delete Upstash Redis databases; run Redis commands (strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, JSON, streams, pub/sub); create and query Upstash Vector indexes; publish, schedule, and inspect QStash messages and the DLQ; manage Upstash Workflow runs; spin up, snapshot, and clone Upstash Box sandboxes; and pull account and billing info.

interface.shortDescription: Drive Upstash Redis, Vector, QStash, Workflow, and Box through the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can manage all your Upstash services — Redis databases, Vector indexes, QStash message queues, Workflow runs, and Box sandboxes. From provisioning a new Redis database to scheduling a QStash message or running a vector search, everything happens through natural language. No more switching between the Upstash console tabs for every task.
defaultPrompt: Show me my Upstash Redis databases and their usage.
Publish a message to QStash to trigger a workflow.
Run a vector search across my Upstash Vector index.
